description: Parliament, Sri Jayawardenepura  - Convening of the Parliament On Tuesday 23rd April 2019 at 1.00 P.m.
reasoning: This gazette content is a notification by the Speaker of Parliament convening a parliamentary session. This falls under electoral and parliamentary processes, specifically the scheduling and convening of legislative sessions, which is categorized under Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) as it deals with the functioning and scheduling of parliamentary business.
